description: NaP₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.36 Å. There are four inequivalent P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ sites. In the first P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing PNaP₃ trigonal pyramids. There are two shorter (2.22 Å) and one longer (2.23 Å) P-P bond length. In the second P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and two P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ atoms. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and one longer (2.17 Å) P-P bond length. In the third P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing PNaP₃ tetrahedra. In the fourth P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ²⁰⁻ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing PNaP₃ tetrahedra.
